description: Using Multiecuscan diagnostic software, complete a full end-to-end diagnostic session on a Fiat Ducato 2.3 JTD. This task requires navigating through ALL major diagnostic screens. In simulation mode: (1) Navigate to Fiat > Ducato and select an engine control module, (2) Start simulation, (3) Read the ECU identification, (4) Read all DTCs, (5) Monitor at least 4 engine parameters including RPM, coolant temperature, battery voltage, and fuel rail pressure, (6) Visualize parameter trends in the graph view, (7) Disconnect, then reconnect to the Body Computer system to check for additional DTCs, (8) Create a comprehensive diagnostic session report at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\MultiecuscanTasks\full_session_report.txt that includes: vehicle and session info, engine ECU identification, engine DTCs with descriptions cross-referenced from the DTC database, engine parameter analysis with values compared to normal ranges from the reference data and OBD logs in MultiecuscanData, body computer DTCs, and an overall assessment with prioritized repair recommendations. This task tests ability to perform a complete, professional-quality diagnostic session.
natural_language: Complete a full diagnostic session on a Fiat Ducato: scan engine ECU (info, errors, parameters, graph), then scan body computer, and produce a comprehensive professional diagnostic report.
